source.title: 2026 Fantasy Football: Dalton Schultz among Justin Boone's top sleeper picks at TE
source.author: Justin Boone

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Boone views Schultz as a high-end TE2 who can finish as a fantasy TE1.
takeaways.rationale: Schultz finished 2025 strongly and Jayden Higgins' season-ending injury creates a path to becoming C.J. Stroud's second target behind Nico Collins.
risks: Jaylin Noel is another ascending target
Schultz is a lower-ceiling veteran compared with elite tight ends

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Boone treats Dulcich as a nearly free deep sleeper with an outside path to top-12 tight end production.
takeaways.rationale: Miami's weak receiver room gives Dulcich a chance to finish top two on the team in targets after a productive 2025 stretch run.
risks: Malik Willis may lead a low-volume passing offense
Dulcich has a long injury history
A weekly starter outcome remains a long shot

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Boone expects Barner to remain a major part of Seattle's passing attack with another Year 3 step possible.
takeaways.rationale: Barner posted repeated top-15 weeks in 2025 and should retain a similar offensive role despite a coordinator change.
risks: He is rehabbing offseason shoulder and ankle surgeries
His production was not yet consistently elite
